preconditions.description: The number of acorns n is between 1 and 500,000.
The length of the Euler tour list a is exactly 2n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the Euler tour list a is between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is 'yes' if a valid Euler tour can be constructed, otherwise 'no'.

postconditions.expression: valid_euler_tour(return_value[1], n) if return_value[0] == 'yes' else True
postconditions.description: If the output is 'yes', the constructed Euler tour is valid.
